item.title: Download Full Installer 6.1.3
item.description:
What's New in Download Full Installer 6.1.3

  • Fix missing alerts:
    • max. concurrent downloads
    • can't create installer app
  • Save latest app window size

What's New in Download Full Installer 6.1.2

  • Add the DMG file size to legacy download cards
  • Add an informational alert when there is insufficient free space

What's New in Download Full Installer 6.1.1

  • Lower the target to macOS 13.5

What's New in Download Full Installer 6.1.0

  • Lower the target to macOS 14.6
  • Add support for High Sierra, Mojave and Catalina installers
  • Replace bundled Sparkle.framework with the Sparkle SPM package
  • Remove app sandboxing environment
